findings.claim: The monthly terrain step still runs a 20-minute cap and a full --refresh every month. D128(f) rules a 25-minute cap (1,500 s), a descriptions-only refresh (--refresh-descriptions), and a full refresh only when the owner asks.
findings.evidence: Line 1241 sets CAP=$(( LEFT < 1200 ? LEFT : 1200 )); line 1243 passes --refresh --deadline-at with DEADLINE = now + CAP - 120, a 1,080 s request window. The P1 cold run took 1,175 s for 1,818 requests (ROADMAP owner item 6; D117(g)), so about 6 to 8 percent of tiles are cut every month and show as paper with Data unavailable. website/terrain.py has no --refresh-descriptions flag. tests/test_hail_workflow.py:390 pins the 1200 cap and --refresh, and DESIGN.md:965, README.md (the terrain command line) and ROADMAP owner item 6 repeat the superseded values.
findings.fix: Use CAP=min(LEFT,1500) with DEADLINE=CAP-120 per D128(f). Add terrain.py build --refresh-descriptions (re-read the two service descriptions; re-fetch a tile only when its cache key's data month changes) and use it in the monthly job; keep --refresh for owner-requested runs. Update the pin at tests/test_hail_workflow.py:390, the DESIGN 13.3 row, the README line and ROADMAP owner item 6.

findings.claim: The held TIGER park source states a free-use licence ('Not copyrighted; free to use in a product or publication'). The sentence reaches the public site in three places: landmarks.py SOURCES terms (line 237), the published index hail/base/index.json sources.tiger_park.terms, and the About data-sources table (website/sources.py:675, printed beside 'Held for counsel'). D115 and D129 say counsel reads the TIGER area landmark file's use constraints before any text from it ships; D121(c) allows a licence sentence only with a cited page read.
findings.evidence: The built about.html tiger_park row reads 'Held for counsel, because the file's use constraints are for counsel to read ... Not copyrighted; acknowledgement to the U.S. Census Bureau as the source is required.' The same text is in hail/base/index.json under sources.tiger_park.terms.
findings.fix: Replace both sentences (landmarks.py:237 and sources.py:675) with 'Recorded as not read; held for counsel.', then rebuild the store index and the About page.

findings.claim: The B6 words test (class B6BaseMapData, checking data/base.json and the B6 keys of data/map.json) cannot fail on words. It runs words_rules.forbidden_words on the JSON text, and the EXEMPT straight-quote pattern removes every JSON string literal before the scan.
findings.evidence: forbidden_words of json.dumps({'note': 'A damage claim.'}) returns []; the same sentence as a bare string returns ['claim', 'damage']. Walking the strings of the built data/base.json finds one hit the test misses: labels.words.legend ('-- means Data unavailable: ... that is not zero and not an all-clear.', build.py:1395), flagged for 'all-clear' because only 'This is not an all-clear' and 'That is not an all-clear' are exempt. The task 1 and task 8 reports of 'base.json 0 hits' come from this same scan.
findings.fix: Assert forbidden_words on each string value (walk the JSON) and add a control fixture that must fail (a planted 'damage'). Then either add the negated form 'not an all-clear' to tests/words_rules.py EXEMPT (it is the D110(c) sentence) or reword the legend, and re-run the gate on the built file.

findings.claim: The B6 About sentences describe browser behaviour that is not built. map.js and map.css are unchanged from HEAD, so the terrain tint, its zoom range, the dark-mode hiding, the Highlight switch, and the bubble and sheet behaviour are not drawn. D130(e) requires these sentences to be checked in the B6-3 browser pass against the page as drawn.
findings.fix: Do not merge this branch to main until B6-3 checks each sentence against the drawn page, or move these sentences behind a flag that stays off until that check passes.

findings.claim: The data/base.json words test cannot fail, and the integrator's 'words gate clean' result for that file is wrong: the file has one real hit.
findings.evidence: The test passes the raw JSON text to words_rules.forbidden_words. Scanning each string value of the built data/base.json finds one hit: labels.words.legend (website/build.py:1395, BUBBLE_LEGEND, the D110(c) sentence ending 'that is not zero and not an all-clear'), because only 'This/That is not an all-clear' is exempt (tests/words_rules.py:39). Task 1 and Task 8 both reported base.json clean.
findings.fix: Scan each string value of the parsed JSON (walk the structure) instead of the raw text, and resolve the D110(c) sentence against the gate: add an exemption for that exact ruled sentence in tests/words_rules.py (a supervisor call) or reword it with approval. Correct the Task 1 and Task 8 notes.

findings.claim: The monthly terrain step is still capped at 20 minutes, not the 25 minutes that D128(f) rules, so the measured cold run loses tiles every month.

findings.claim: The monthly terrain verify can be killed by its own 300 s timeout, and the kill removes the month's terrain layers.
findings.evidence: verify re-fetches its 10-tile sample one after another (website/terrain.py:1271, 'for rel in picks'). Each re-fetch allows 60 s per try and up to three tries (TRIES=3, terrain.py:160; retry loop 549-564). A slow service can run past `timeout --kill-after=30 300`. Exit 124 leaves `verified` unset, so the mark step (line 1266) runs `terrain unavailable` and removes the layers for the month.
findings.fix: Give the monthly verify a budget that fits its sample (for example a 4-tile sample in the monthly job, or the remaining clock), and report a re-fetch that timed out as 'not checked' rather than failing the whole layer.
